name: Wise Sentinel
backstory: The Wise Sentinel is a unique type of Undead guarding the secret shrine to Shar underneath the statue of Ketheric Thorm in Reithwin Town's square. Its abilities mirror that of a Cleric, and fitting of its role it has very high Wisdom.
